name: technical-seo-toolkit
description: Crawlability, indexation, structured data and measurement patterns for technical SEO, with a failing and a corrected example for each, 92 catalogued findings one per reason, every one driven out of a real call in the test suite, and 14 declared limits each asserted with a blind case and a contrast case.

scripts.test: node --test --test-reporter=tap test/analytics.test.mjs test/canonical.test.mjs test/catalogue.test.mjs test/defects.test.mjs test/headings.test.mjs test/hreflang.test.mjs test/jsonld.test.mjs test/limits.test.mjs test/pairs.test.mjs test/redirects.test.mjs test/repo.test.mjs test/robots.test.mjs test/sitemap.test.mjs test/tools.test.mjs
